changelog: Ship migration 2026_09_24_0001_fix_double_counted_funding_in_net_pnl.sql via the standard updater/migrate.php path — v3.18.1 committed this file but deliberately left it out of files/db_migrations. Now deployed like every other tracked migration (see migrations/2026_09_23_0001 in v3.18.0 for the same pattern): the updater copies it into the live migrations/ folder, and it is applied by hand via migrate.php?mode=run (never automatically by the updater itself).

The migration file was trimmed to its single UPDATE statement — migrate.php executes every statement in a migration via PDO::exec() and its report only ever shows applied/failed + timing, with no path to display a SELECT's result set, so the preview/verify SELECTs v3.18.1's manual version had would run with their output going nowhere. The preview query is now given in the file's own header comment for eyeballing by hand (phpMyAdmin/mysql CLI) before mode=run, not embedded as a statement the runner would silently discard.
release_notes: Deploys migration 2026_09_24_0001 (repairs net_pnl double-counted funding). Back up DB, then run migrate.php?mode=status, then mode=run.
